// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A typed function per route of each HTTP server, sending its arguments and
// decoding its result as the servers' JSON. Framework-neutral: hooks.ts adds
// React on top.

import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/** Runs proc P: `POST /api/p` on http server web-api. */
export async function p(args: { readonly r: $t.RStringList }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<$t.RInt> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/p", {
    "r": $enc_RStringList(args.r),
  }, opts);
  return $dec_RInt(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_RStringList(x: $t.RStringList): unknown {
  return {
    "x": $encList($encString)(x.x),
    "pos": $encInt(x.pos),
  };
}

export function $dec_RStringList(v: unknown, at: string): $t.RStringList {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    x: $decList($decString)($field(o, "x", at), at + ".x"),
    pos: $decInt($field(o, "pos", at), at + ".pos"),
  };
}

export function $enc_RInt(x: $t.RInt): unknown {
  return {
    "x": $encInt(x.x),
    "pos": $encInt(x.pos),
  };
}

export function $dec_RInt(v: unknown, at: string): $t.RInt {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    x: $decInt($field(o, "x", at), at + ".x"),
    pos: $decInt($field(o, "pos", at), at + ".pos"),
  };
}

export function $enc_PArgs(x: $t.PArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "r": $enc_RStringList(x.r),
  };
}

export function $dec_PArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.PArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    r: $dec_RStringList($field(o, "r", at), at + ".r"),
  };
}

==== hooks.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";
import type * as $t from "./types";

/**
 * Runs proc P through p (`POST /api/p` on http server web-api): with args,
 * whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useP(args?: { readonly r: $t.RStringList } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly r: $t.RStringList }, $t.RInt> {
  return $useCall($c.p, args, opts);
}
